mentions.name: Runzone
mentions.description: This is an iOS and watchOS app for runners that provides workout and fitness tracking, aiming to fill gaps the author found in most existing fitness apps.
mentions.problem: Most existing workout and fitness tracking apps did not do what the author wanted, leaving a meaningful gap for runners.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on an iOS / watchOS app for runners, workout and fitness tracking. I found most apps not doing what I wanted and hope I'll be able to close a meaningful gap.  https://runzone.app
